title: Canonicalize MarketingSkills as an optional untrusted skill-package provider with fail-closed admission
rationale: The upstream project is a useful versioned marketing Agent Skills and evaluation pattern source.
The upstream repository also contains executable CLI/script surfaces, a symlink, and documented shell interpolation, so repository presence cannot imply execution trust.

FA3 therefore admits only immutable, digest-bound selected skill packages and keeps all execution, credentials, authorization, workflow, evidence, customer-state and provider-ranking authority outside the skill package.
Commercial affiliation is provenance metadata only and cannot alter ranking, authorization or policy.
